_source: Ministry of Education / Curriculum Development Centre, Zambia. 'Civic Education Syllabus Grade 10-12' (2013, published by CDC) — Grade 12, Topics 12.1-12.6. Topic and Specific Outcome statements only; the 'Content' (Knowledge/Skills/Values) columns are omitted for the same reason documented in the Grade 10 file. Sub-topics are not separately named in the source table for this grade, so each topic is modeled with a single sub-topic bearing the same name as the topic, purely to satisfy this app's data schema (same approach as Grade 10). Two of the same kind of source-document numbering slip found in Grade 11 recur here and were corrected the same way, cross-checked against the syllabus's own Appendix One 'Scope and Sequence Chart': Topic 12.1 (International Human Rights Instruments) has its outcomes printed as 11.3.1-11.3.5, renumbered 12.1.1-12.1.5. Topic 12.6 (Global Issues) has its outcomes printed as 12.7.1-12.7.8, renumbered 12.6.1-12.6.8. Additionally, under 12.5 Poverty Reduction in Zambia, outcome code 12.5.3 is printed twice for two different outcomes ('Assess the effects of poverty' and 'Discuss poverty alleviation strategies') and was renumbered sequentially from the point of duplication. Topics 12.2 (Rights of a Child), 12.3 (Family Law) and 12.4 (Development Planning) were printed correctly with no numbering issues. The syllabus organizes content by Grade only, not by Term, so all of Grade 12 is modeled as a single term here.

subject.name: Civic Education
subject.description: Senior Secondary Civic Education syllabus, Grade 10-12 (Curriculum Development Centre, 2013).

terms.name: Year (not term-divided in the source syllabus)

competencies.description: Describe the International Bill of Rights (IBR)
Explain the Universal Declaration of Human Rights (UDHR)
Describe Treaty Based Human Rights Instruments
Discuss the Specialised Human Rights Instruments
Explain provisions of the African Charter on Human and People's Rights
Describe Children's Rights
Describe the four principles of the United Nations Convention on the Rights of the Child (UNCRC)
Discuss the provisions of the UNCRC and the two optional protocols
Describe family and marriage
Explain the elements of Family Law
Describe types of marriages in Zambia
Assess the effects of separation, divorce and death on the family
Explain development planning
Discuss types of development planning
Describe methods of planning
Discuss the importance of budgeting and fiscal discipline in development planning
Explain the functions of micro and macro-economic financial institutions
Examine indicators of development
Outline Zambia's National Development Plans from Independence to present
Describe poverty
Explain the causes of poverty
Assess the effects of poverty
Discuss poverty alleviation strategies
Evaluate poverty alleviation strategies and their implementation in Zambia
Explain globalisation and global issues
Discuss bilateral and multilateral aid
Discuss international trade
State the role of the World Trade Organisation (WTO)
Explain debt crisis and debt relief
Discuss the effects of debt crisis on Zambia
Explain Millennium Development Goals (MDGs)
Analyse Zambia's efforts towards the attainment of the Millennium Development Goals
